saw_lines: Fragrance buyers test on skin, then keep one signature for years, and most go back to the same bottle when it runs out.
So the sale is decided before the offer is read, when the buyer decides if the scent suits them.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it, so put it in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to act. Put the first order discount in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to trust before the click. Lead three new ads with one number, such as reviews or orders shipped, and repeat it on the creative.

22 ads have run 60 days or more, so that copy is the one to learn from. Build three variations of the oldest winner, the escape the ordinary Lilacs ad, keeping its opening line and changing the visual and closing line.
Shop now sits on 28 of 30 ads, but 5 of them land on the ScentList page, so a buyer who clicks to shop gets a sign up. Match each button to its page: Shop now for products, Join for ScentList.
